content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Meteorologist Noah Bergren's PostMeteorologist Noah Bergren Verified accountMarch 31 at 11:13 PM · Shared with PublicTHE BIG, HISTORIC DAY: You will see Artemis in the sky as far away as Miami and Savannah, Georgia. Best viewing will be in central Florida though. Will be seen about 20-30 seconds after launch around Disney World and Universal. After about 40,000 feet, nobody can see it anymore. There will be some clouds scattered across the state of Florida that could mask the view in the sky towards the east, but most should see it.
